entries.acceptance_evidence: Blocked pending written eCarsTrade authorization: section 13 of the official terms prohibits saving, reproducing, distributing, or making platform data public without written consent (https://ecarstrade.com/terms-and-conditions).

entries.acceptance_evidence: Blocked pending written Ayvens authorization: the official legal notice prohibits reproduction, representation, diffusion, re-diffusion, and caching without prior written authorization (https://carmarket.ayvens.com/en-ma/GDPRLegalNotice).

entries.vehicle_auction_type: سيارات متضررة وحوادث وقيم متبقية للتأمين

entries.vehicle_auction_type: إعادة تسويق وأساطيل وتداول عابر للحدود
